source_mapping: dataset_manifest.json;source_id0..7 unique across seed and condition
flags_reward_info: each N records;original terminated/truncated preserved;budget end does not change flags
feedback_audit: M=N-9 actual decisions only;t/reference_state_index/actual_state_index int64(M,);q_ref,q_actual,error_rad,u_ff,correction,u_raw,u_clipped_float64 float64(M,);u_sent float32(M,);was_clipped/sent_at_bound bool(M,);controller_target_qpos float32(M,7)
feedback_inputs: raw current joint1 angle,known same-seed reference obs[t] joint1,reference actions[t,0];no state standardization
diagnostics: cube pose xyz(m)+wxyz quaternion;arm/gripper target;success;not feedback inputs
comparison: states9..minimum completed steps inclusive;both observed21states and20actions in every current source
r_on_minus_r_off_rad: signed finite-condition contrast,not a general causal-effect estimate
tracking_deviation_rad: q_group[k]-q_U[k];opposite sign to feedback error q_ref-q_actual
scope: two already used seeds,known reference and clock;no training,parameter fitting,significance tests or task-success inference
